svg.title: Battle HUD, phone portrait
svg.desc: Phone portrait battle screen at 390 x 844 pt: top strip, Top lens on the target fort, Field Strip map with Pins, Bottom lens on your fort, shot tray, crew row and Fire. Side cells show the joined lens in flight, block sizes, turning the device and the thumb zone.

text.font-family: Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif
